verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Come they told me,
pa rum pum pum pum
A new born King to see,
pa rum pum pum pum

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Our finest gifts we bring,
pa rum pum pum pum
To lay before the King,
pa rum pum pum pum,

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
rum pum pum pum,
rum pum pum pum,

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
So to honor Him,
pa rum pum pum pum,
When we come.

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Little Baby,
pa rum pum pum pum
I am a poor boy too,
pa rum pum pum pum

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
I have no gift to bring,
pa rum pum pum pum
That's fit to give the King,
pa rum pum pum pum,

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
rum pum pum pum,
rum pum pum pum,

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Shall I play for you,
pa rum pum pum pum,
On my drum?

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Mary nodded,
pa rum pum pum pum
The ox and lamb kept time,
pa rum pum pum pum

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
I played my drum for Him,
pa rum pum pum pum
I played my best for Him,
pa rum pum pum pum,

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines:
rum pum pum pum,
rum pum pum pum,

verse.name: v3e
verse.lines:
Then He smiled at me,
pa rum pum pum pum
Me and my drum.
